observations: body: the line numbers 5 to 20 stand in the left margin and the locator «p. 207.» (L17) in the right margin; 20 stands beside the line «Haec est sciotherici imago (b).». The signature 18 stands at the foot of the page, at the right.
body L19, L20: the letters of the references (a) and (b) are bold italic.

body L20-L21: the line «Haec est sciotherici imago (b).» is set in bold and centred over the figure; the line «Ad similitudinem divisionis horum duorum quadrantum duos quadrantes reliquos, Deo volente, divides.» is set in roman and centred under it, its first letters «Ad simili» printed heavier (stems 1.44 pt against 1.08 pt in the rest of the line).

figure: the image of the sundial is redrawn from the print (figures/AB01-PDF0226-F01.tex): the plate in a double frame, with the letters B and A beside its upper corners and C and D beside its lower corners, at the height of the lines above and below it; the line of east and west (ORIENS, OCCIDENS) and the meridian (MERIDIES, LINEA MERIDIANA, SEPTENTRIONES); the circle about E in three rings, divided into degrees between the outer two rings from the meridian to the east and from the west to the meridian, with longer strokes at every fifth and tenth degree and the numbers 10 to 90 in the eastern quadrant; the dashed lines of Cancer and Capricorn and the eleven hour lines from M to L, with the spaces HORA I to HORA XII; the stilus ES; the dashed line K T K, the dotted line N T N and the azimuth of the qiblah from E through T to P’ on the circle.
figure: the dotted line N T N is not drawn between the line of Cancer and the line of Capricorn, where the labels HORA VII stand beside it.
figure: on the scan the left lines of the frame bow toward the gutter (by up to 4.5 pt); the redrawing sets them straight and moves the left part of the drawing with them.
figure: a round speck stands before «HORA» in the space of hour X; it is not a sign.
body L7, L17, L19: specks stand at the foot of the r of «boream» (L7), before the n of «numera» and under the s of «ortus» (L17), and after «(a).» (L19); they are not signs.
